_envVarsRequired.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key for sending team invite emails (get one at https://resend.com)
_envVarsRequired.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: Supabase service role key — used by api/notify.js to update team_members server-side

_note: Set RESEND_API_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel Dashboard > Project > Settings > Environment Variables
